leadText:
Teacher (Japanese: 保母 Kindergarten Teacher) is a character of the day who appeared in The Lonely Snover!.

She appeared at the end of the episode with the kindergarten children that she teaches. She informed that the next Pokémon Contest venue will be held in Sandalstraw Town.
